description_en: Switches a container service to development mode or exits development mode
description_zh: 将容器服务转为开发模式，或退出开发模式
kebab_example: aliyun eas develop-service --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name echo --exit true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DevelopService

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the service is deployed
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to exit development mode. Valid values:

true: exits development mode.
false (default): enters development mode
parameters.name: exit
